book_title: Eleanor Roosevelt: Volume 2 , The Defining Years, 1933-1938
author: Blanche Wiesen Cook
book_description: The second volume in the best-selling biography of America's visionary First Lady examines Eleanor Roosevelt's growing influence on the history and policy of America during the White House years and the Depression, as she championed racial justice, women's rights, and more. 75,000 first printing. First serial, Mirabella. Tour.
